overview: The Opus 800 range offers a wide choice of gas and electric appliances of high quality, durability & performance.

The Lincat Opus 800 twin tank fryer with pumped filtration is the solution for any commercial kitchen's frying needs! With two independent fryer tanks it provides greater versatility and means you can fry delicious food more accurately at the correct temperatures. The convenient piezo ignition allows for quick lighting and getting the oil to temperature quickly.

When it comes to filtering, the two stage filtration provides extended life to your oil, up to 75%, which means less oil purchases. Plus, the feature of being able to pump hot oil makes this product revolutionary. It means you can filter during service, making it more efficient and in just 5 minutes, your oil is filtered and ready to use again!
The OG8111/OP2 comes with batter plates, baskets, full lids and stainless steel bucket so once it is installed, you’ll have everything you need to get started (except the oil of course).
The Lincat Opus 800 twin tank fryer is stainless steel so easy to clean and, as it comes on castors, it can be manoeuvred easily to get round the back on deep clean days.
The twin fryer is ideal for busier kitchens which require fried foods to be cooked at different temperatures or need the availability of foods to be cooked at different times.
The Lincat Opus 800 tin tank fryer is Ideal for a variety of busy commercial and professional kitchens, whether it's a large pub or a restaurant or smaller takeaway shop.

overview: The Lainox Oracle XS is a compact commercial high-speed oven and the latest addition to Lainox's popular Oracle range. Despite its compact design, the Oracle XS delivers exceptional performance by combining three cooking technologies - microwave, fan-assisted convection and impingement - to produce outstanding and consistent cooking results at high speed.

The Oracle XS offers two versatile cooking modes. High Speed Oven mode harnesses all three cooking technologies simultaneously for ultra-fast cooking, while Combi Wave mode allows the operator to choose between microwave, convection, or a combination of both, providing maximum flexibility for a wide variety of menu items.
Adding to its versatility, the Oracle XS is powered by a standard 13A power supply, allowing for simple installation and portability.
